preprocessed_tickets.subject: Posts Sort Order
preprocessed_tickets.first_message:
Hello team,

We have now renewed the support for 60 $ although we are of the opinion that the error is not due to us ...

We are using the Decibel theme (latest version), and WPBakery is integrated according to the theme. Unfortunately, our blog posts are not sorted correctly by publication date – although everything is correct in the backend and the display is set to ‘Date DESC’.

The ‘Display Posts’ plugin and our own orderby filters in a mini-plugin also had no effect.

Is there something we are overlooking – or is this a known issue with the decibel_output_posts() function?

Many thanks and best regards
